title: Pointless Machine
statementMd:
*This is an interactive problem.*

Madeline is playing with a pointless machine. The pointless machine has a hidden tree of size $n$, and Madeline has to find the edges of the tree by asking the machine.

In a query, Madeline will give the machine a permutation $p$ of $[1,2,\ldots,n]$, and the machine will return a sequence $q_1, q_2, \ldots, q_n$, where $q_i$ is the number of edges of the induced subgraph formed by the vertices $\{p_1,p_2,\ldots,p_i\}$.

Here, an induced subgraph of a graph $G(V,E)$ formed by a subset of vertices $V' \subseteq V$, is a graph consisting of vertices from this subset and all edges between vertices from subset that are present in original graph $G$.

However, the machine works slowly, so Madeline can only get the results at once after all queries are completed. The memory of this machine is not very large either, so Madeline can only ask $31$ times. She doesn't know how to solve it, so she invited you to help her.

Note that the interactor is **non-adaptive**. That is, tree is fixed in advance and doesn't change with your queries.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The only line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($3\le n\le 5\cdot 10^4$) — the size of the tree.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $5\cdot 10^4$.

## Interaction

The interaction begins by reading the integer $n$.

Then, output a single integer $k$ ($1 \leq k \leq 31$) — the number of queries.

To ask a query, output a line in the following format:

- $p_{i,1}\,p_{i,2}\,\ldots\,p_{i,n}$ ($1 \leq p_{i,j} \leq n$, the $p_{i,j}$ are distinct for each $i$) — a query described above.

Once you've asked all $k$ queries, read $k$ lines of $n$ integers $q_{i,j}$ — the responses to the queries as described above.

When you know the hidden tree, output $n-1$ lines in the following format:

- $u,v$ ($1\leq u,v\leq n$) — an edge $(u,v)$ in the hidden tree.

Then, move on to the next test case, or terminate the program if there are no more test cases.

After printing all $k$ queries do not forget to output the end of line and flush$^{\text{∗}}$ the output. Otherwise, you will get `Idleness limit exceeded` verdict.

If, at any interaction step, you read $-1$ instead of valid data, your solution must exit immediately. This means that your solution will receive `Wrong answer` because of an invalid query or any other mistake. Failing to exit can result in an arbitrary verdict because your solution will continue to read from a closed stream.

**Hacks**

To hack, use the following format.

The first line should contain a single integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$).

The second line of each test case should contain a single integer $n$ ($3 \le n \le 5\cdot 10^4$).

$i$-th out of next $n - 1$ lines should contain two integers $u_i, v_i$ ($1 \le u_i, v_i \le n$).

Given edges should form a tree, and the sum of $n$ over all test cases shouldn't exceed $5 \cdot 10^4$.

$^{\text{∗}}$To flush, use: `fflush(stdout)` or `cout.flush()` in C++; `sys.stdout.flush()` in Python; see the documentation for other languages.

## Note

[Visualizer link](https://codeforces.com/assets/contests/2164/G_tu5eequaequohNa5yai0.html)

For the first test case:

- The first query has answer `0 1 2`, since only edge $(1, 2)$ is in the induced subgraph formed by $\{1,2\}$.
- The second query has answer `0 0 2`, since no edges are in the induced subgraph formed by $\{1,3\}$.

For the third test case:

- Edges $(2,3)$, $(3,4)$, and $(4,1)$ are in the induced subgraph formed by $\{1,2,3,4\}$, so $q_{1,4}=3$.
statementZhMd:
*这是一道交互题。*

Madeline 正在一台无用的机器上玩耍。这台机器里藏着一棵大小为 $n$ 的树，Madeline 需要通过向机器询问来找出这棵树的边。

在一次询问中，Madeline 会给机器一个 $[1,2,\ldots,n]$ 的排列 $p$，机器会返回一个序列 $q_1, q_2, \ldots, q_n$，其中 $q_i$ 表示由顶点 $\{p_1,p_2,\ldots,p_i\}$ 导出的子图的边数。

这里，图 $G(V,E)$ 中由顶点子集 $V' \subseteq V$ 导出的子图，是由该子集中的顶点以及原图 $G$ 中存在于这些顶点之间的所有边组成的图。

然而，这台机器运行得很慢，Madeline 只能在所有询问都完成之后一次性拿到结果。这台机器的内存也不大，所以 Madeline 只能询问 $31$ 次。她不知道该怎么解决，于是请你来帮她。

请注意，交互器是**非自适应的**。也就是说，这棵树是事先确定的，不会随你的询问而改变。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例仅一行，包含一个整数 $n$（$3\le n\le 5\cdot 10^4$），表示树的大小。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $5\cdot 10^4$。

## 交互

交互从读取整数 $n$ 开始。

然后，输出一个整数 $k$（$1 \leq k \leq 31$），表示询问的次数。

要进行一次询问，请按以下格式输出一行：

- $p_{i,1}\,p_{i,2}\,\ldots\,p_{i,n}$（$1 \leq p_{i,j} \leq n$，且对于每个 $i$，$p_{i,j}$ 互不相同）——如上所述的一次询问。

在完成全部 $k$ 次询问后，读取 $k$ 行、每行 $n$ 个整数 $q_{i,j}$，即如上所述对这些询问的回答。

当你确定了隐藏的树之后，按以下格式输出 $n-1$ 行：

- $u,v$（$1\leq u,v\leq n$）——隐藏树中的一条边 $(u,v)$。

然后，继续处理下一个测试用例；如果没有更多测试用例，则结束程序。

在输出全部 $k$ 次询问后，不要忘记输出行末换行符并刷新$^{\text{∗}}$输出缓冲区，否则你将得到 `Idleness limit exceeded` 的判定结果。

如果在交互的任意一步中，你读到 $-1$ 而不是有效数据，你的程序必须立即退出。这意味着你的程序会因为一次无效的询问或其他错误而收到 `Wrong answer`。如果不退出，你的程序将继续从已关闭的流中读取数据，从而可能得到任意判定结果。

**Hack**

若要 Hack，请使用以下格式。

第一行应包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。

每个测试用例的第二行应包含一个整数 $n$（$3 \le n \le 5\cdot 10^4$）。

接下来的 $n - 1$ 行中，第 $i$ 行应包含两个整数 $u_i, v_i$（$1 \le u_i, v_i \le n$）。

给定的边应构成一棵树，且所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不应超过 $5 \cdot 10^4$。

$^{\text{∗}}$刷新方法：在 C++ 中使用 `fflush(stdout)` 或 `cout.flush()`；在 Python 中使用 `sys.stdout.flush()`；其他语言请查阅相应文档。

## 说明

[可视化链接](https://codeforces.com/assets/contests/2164/G_tu5eequaequohNa5yai0.html)

对于第一个测试用例：

- 第一次询问的答案为 `0 1 2`，因为由 $\{1,2\}$ 导出的子图中只有边 $(1, 2)$。
- 第二次询问的答案为 `0 0 2`，因为由 $\{1,3\}$ 导出的子图中没有边。

对于第三个测试用例：

- 边 $(2,3)$、$(3,4)$ 和 $(4,1)$ 都在由 $\{1,2,3,4\}$ 导出的子图中，因此 $q_{1,4}=3$。
